message.text: I realize my earlier grep must have been run from /bench rather than /bench/repo, which explains the mismatched relative path. Let me just read the file at the correct absolute path directly.

This confirms the single call site. `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` is the sole handler that invokes `s.Store.CreateMemo`; `CreateMemoComment` reaches the store indirectly only by calling `s.CreateMemo` itself (not `Store.CreateMemo` directly).
